title: Crop file (data/crops/<id>.json, one crop per file)
description: Something that grows in the hero's plot (GDD §7, TECH_DESIGN §20): how long it takes, the seed that plants it, what a harvest gives and what Tilda pays. Every item id must be in data/items. A new crop needs no new logic: this file, a seed item, the item it gives, and its pictures (named in FarmPlot.CROP_FRAMES and ItemIcons.FRAMES).

name.description: As the game says it: "Pick the Turnip".

days.description: How many watered mornings it takes to ripen. A morning after a dry day doesn't count; two of those in a row wither it (data/rules/farm.json).

seed.description: The item that plants it: an item of type 'seed' whose stats.crop is this crop's id.

gives.description: What a harvest puts in the pack.

seed_price.description: What one seed costs at Tilda's, in coins.

sells_for.description: What Tilda pays for one of what it gives, in coins.
